name: SatQuery Agent Evaluation - frozen mission set (G17, 100 missions)
note: NOT an external benchmark. 50 frozen missions over local demo fixtures. Metrics measure the PLANNER + POLICY + EXECUTOR (plan validity, tool selection, dependency validity, mission completion, evidence/verification retention, unsupported-action rate, recovery, unnecessary tool calls, early-stop efficiency, latency) - NOT model accuracy. Each mission encodes what a CORRECT agent SHOULD DO, never the exact answer. | G17: first 50 = the G15/G16 frozen set verbatim (+ expected_intent); ss/tm/os/mi/ad 11-20 = paraphrase / scenario variants. expected_intent = the typed Intent a correct extractor should produce.
